title: 5.2.28 Reading: update() runs before physics
description: moSHion runs a third function on every frame, update(), before the physics step moves the sprites; draw() runs after it. So the rules of the game (keys, movement, the jump) can go in update(), and the picture (background, words) stays in draw(). Read before 5.2.29 Lab: Rules in update(), picture in draw().
